# Lane 2.155 part 2: handover

## Builder one (2026-11-24)

The brief's first form, the box score, landed in part 1 already (commit 2ca56df7; `tests/browser/box-score*` and the games area's `form-state.ts`, `saved-line.tsx`, `use-one-submit.ts`). This builder left it alone, and nothing in the admin games area changed in this lane (lanes 2.130 and 2.159 are open there).

What exists:

- The shared mechanism is `apps/web/src/features/list-forms` (from step 2.49), with `server/saved-notice.ts` (a notice read once, so a reload says nothing old) and `server/same-request.ts` (a repeat post gets the first post's answer). Added here: `answerSavedAt` (a thing just made: the browser goes to its own page with scripts on or off, and the notice is said there); `ListForm` puts the focus on the first marked box after a refusal; a select may be optional (`required: false`); a `main` button. Part 1's copy in the games area was not merged in (open lanes).
- Converted: "Add team" (`teams-area/teams-page.tsx`, `actions.ts` `createTeamAction`, new `create-team-answer.ts` with its test). Refused: name, short name, color, the own-colors tick and the division keep what was typed; the wrong box is marked and its sentence is beside it and names it. Saved: the new team's page says "Saved: <name> was added to the season." at the top, once (`team-page.tsx`, three small insertions).
- `scripts/check-web-shell.mjs` `post()` now also sends a form that has its own state, using all of its hidden `$ACTION…` fields. Eight browser tests waited for `?done=created` and now wait for the team's page, `#add-team` allowed (with scripts off the browser keeps the form's fragment across the redirect).
- Decisions: `decisions-pending/T-396.md`, `U-19.md` (Decided for you). T-397 to T-400 and S-108 are unused.

What ran and passed: `npm run check`, `npm run typecheck`, `npm test` (433), the vitest files for teams-area and saved-notice (36 tests), `npm run test:web` (288 checks), and the browser tests team-kept (34 checks, new), activity-log, bin-screen, one-world, team-bin, undo-removing, harmful-text, coin-flip and admin-teams-on-database. I broke the code by hand once: with `refusedWith` dropping what was typed, team-kept failed on 8 checks; with a code given the wrong box, the unit test failed.

What is left (builder two): the forms below; the games area's copy of the mechanism; the spec words "after a save the confirmation names the thing" are A-4's meaning, so I did not correct P4.

What I distrust: `npm test` passed (433 tests, the two decision files folded), but the heading I gave U-19 in the full list (P4) holds no other U- row. `adminTeams.done.created` is no longer said anywhere, but it is still listed in `answer.ts` `doneNames`.

- Item 1: the eight browser tests builder one changed (activity-log, admin-teams-on-database, bin-screen, first-test-walk, harmful-text twice, one-world, team-bin, undo-removing) now also wait, ten seconds at most, for the new team's page to say "Saved: <name> was added to the season." ## Builder three (2026-11-24)

- Item 1, the grid's leftovers (T-398): a refused "Swap with" rides back with its game and the game chosen (`at=swap`, `#swap-<game>`), is said beside that game's swap box ("Swap places with: …"), the box marked and keeping the choice, never at the top. Every answer, a refusal too, now leaves the one-time notice, and `answerShown` drops a refusal's words and what was typed once it is gone, so a reload repeats no refusal. New shared `list-forms/marked-focus.tsx` puts the focus on a plain server form's marked box with scripts on (`autoFocus` alone did not: checked).
- Converted on a team's page: "Team details" (rename, short name, colors, division) and "Someone not in the list yet" (names, number, role), each a `ListForm` through one helper, `answerTeamForm` in `teams-area/actions.ts`, with `team-form-answer.ts` (and its test) naming the box: refused, every box as typed, the wrong one marked, its sentence beside it naming it, focus there; saved, "Saved: the details of <name>." beside the form, or "Saved: <name> was added to <team>." on the new roster line; a reload says neither; a double tap saves once (same-request store).
- Six browser tests that waited for `?done=added` now wait for that line on the new roster line (admin-teams-on-database, bin-screen, first-test-walk, one-world, undo-removing; harmful-text waits for the marked number box). `check-web-shell` expects the new player's 303 to the team's page and its line, and a forged team id refused in the answer to the post.
- Ran and passed: `npm run check`, `npm run typecheck`, `npm run test:web` (288), vitest of schedule-builder (61), teams-area and site (127); browser: schedule-kept (59), team-page-kept (46, new), admin-teams-on-database (66), team-kept (34), team-bin (64), bin-screen (26), undo-removing (71), one-world (27); harmful-text (2207), refusal (70), first-test-walk (110), players-panel (48), coach-finds-team (101); `npm test` (433). refusal first failed: a club admin's refused new player was drawn again without the form (it is not offered to them) and its sentence went with it; a "not allowed" is now said in the form as tapped, the page not drawn again. Broken by hand: with the swap refusal never read, schedule-kept failed waiting for it beside the game; with a refusal's words read on every load, it failed "a reload repeats no refusal"; with `refusedWith` given nothing typed, team-page-kept failed on every "kept".
- Left, in order (the later part): on the team page, "Add to the roster" from the league list, a line's number and role, mark as left, put back, remove person, move, stats, remove team, team left and back (still `runTeamsAction`, answers in the address); League settings (`settings-area/run-settings-action.ts`); Season settings (`season-settings/actions.ts`; leave the "Statistics kept" form to its open lane); then People, the bin and the games area's own copy as listed below.

The team details form's hidden `version` comes from the page as drawn, so a refusal for a team changed meanwhile asks for a second save. A worn number is not refused in the stand-in league (numbers may repeat there), so the number's refusal was walked only for a number that is not one.
